resolvedFinding.explanation: AppLayoutPort.close retains the original invocation and plugin signal while the modal is merely prepared. App confirms view identity then commits that retained authorization synchronously before closeNow. Commit rechecks the original lifetime and consumes once. The new selected integration case rejects old confirmation after plugin disable/re-enable, layout A→B→A, or authentication replacement, and allows a fresh confirmation exactly once. Native close keeps its own path.
resolvedFinding.evidenceBoundary: The exercised case uses actual PluginHost/AppLayoutPort with controlled App actions. Mounted App modal cancel/confirm/retained-draft coverage is written in the browser journey but has not run.

reviewedDesign: The bounded reference-only layout owns workspace membership, active panes and ratios; it does not duplicate business drafts, C/Symbol/attachment controllers or command authority.

All open keyed ChatPane wrappers are siblings under one stable parent across split/merge/reorder; hidden workspace references remain mounted and use the same visible-set decision as projection and message-settings visibility.

Layout invocation is captured before plugin activation awaits, checked again in the bridge and private App port, and revoked on old layout/connection/plugin lifetimes. Declared arguments and local resource identity are checked.

Stream leases reserve FIFO waiters before waking and yield after completed bounded batches while preserving hasMore work. The new fairness and hidden-waiter HTTP cases are necessary but not yet executed.

Workspace close waits for recovery flush and revalidates connection generation plus exact view-key membership; persisted local layout is bounded to 8 workspaces/3 panes/32 open references and excludes private draft data.
